review_rationale: Source registration renewed after binding Clause 10 pointer-assignment syntax fixtures (batch158). Classification and remaining pending plans re-verified by an independent reviewer; semantic facets of 10.2.2.3 are not discharged here. Five frozen-LFortran failures were independently confirmed as genuine: it accepts type, kind, rank and non-TARGET mismatches that the constraints require it to diagnose, and crashes on a vector-subscripted target.
